title: Walk through a range
summary: Swift: Walk through a range. Try 1...4. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: The closed range 1...3 includes 1, 2 and 3. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Walk through a range with Swift

blocks.text: Install Swift or use Xcode on a Mac. Save each example as lesson.swift and run swift lesson.swift.
The three-dot range includes its end. The loop therefore prints three numbers.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: 1..<3 leaves out 3; three dots include it.
